rca_of_issues.review_assets_count_zero: ReviewStep.jsx line 23: `const a = trustCase.assets || []` uses trustCase.assets field. OwnStep saves items to separate asset_items collection via POST /trust-cases/{id}/asset-items endpoint. These are two different data stores. ReviewStep would only show assets from trustCase.assets, not from asset_items. This design split means test N (Assets count=1) can only pass if the asset is saved to trustCase.assets directly, not via OwnStep.
rca_of_issues.admin_delete_404: DELETE /api/admin/users/{user_id} returns 404 - likely a pre-existing field mismatch (checking 'id' vs '_id'). Workaround: direct MongoDB delete. Issue noted in iterations 42+.
